module purpose: This module buffers input words in a single-word register or in an indexed memory array, maintains separate write and read position state, returns a selected stored word on rdata_o, and reports fill and availability status on level_o, free_o, avail_o, and half_o. Generic-controlled variants add safe request gating, synchronous or asynchronous readout, and optional storage reset.

use-case flows.value: accepted write request derived from we_i and, in FIFO_SAFE builds, free
accepted read request derived from re_i and, in FIFO_SAFE builds, avail
write incoming data into fifo_reg or fifo_mem and update write/read position state
stored data returned on rdata_o from fifo_reg or from fifo_mem at the current read location
fill level and status flags derived from the pointer state and driven on level_o, free_o, avail_o, and half_o
write/read position state cleared to zero by rstn_i or by clear_i through the next-state logic, with optional storage and synchronous-status reset to zero

conceptual assets.reasoning: Line 65 computes the internal write-accept decision `we` from `we_i` and, when `FIFO_SAFE = true`, `free`. That decision gates the write-pointer next state at line 82 and the actual data stores at lines 134-150 and 170-184. Integrity is established because a corrupted `we` changes whether an input word is accepted, whether the write position advances, and whether storage captures `wdata_i`. Availability is also established under the implemented condition that `we_i = '1'` and, in safe builds, `free = '1'`.

Line 64 computes the internal read-accept decision `re` from `re_i` and, when `FIFO_SAFE = true`, `avail`. That decision gates the read-pointer next state at line 83, which is captured into `r_pnt` at line 77 and, on the asynchronous large-depth path, into `r_pnt_ff` at line 210 before selecting `rdata_o` at line 213; the synchronous large-depth path reads using `r_pnt` at line 241. Integrity is established because a corrupted `re` changes whether the FIFO advances its read position and therefore which stored word is returned next. Availability is established under the implemented condition that `re_i = '1'` and, in safe builds, `avail = '1'`.

conceptual assets.concept: Buffered payload data words stored for later readout
conceptual assets.reasoning: Accepted input data are copied from `wdata_i` into `fifo_reg` at lines 135/171 or into `fifo_mem` at lines 150/184 when `we = '1'`; readout returns `fifo_reg` directly at lines 201/232 or a selected `fifo_mem` entry at lines 213/241. Integrity is established because the read-out flow depends on `rdata_o` delivering exactly the stored word defined by the active storage and read path. Availability is established after an accepted write until the stored entry is later selected for read, overwritten by later writes, or invalidated by clear/reset behavior; `FULL_RESET` builds additionally drive storage to zero at lines 132/147.

conceptual assets.concept: FIFO storage position state selecting where data are written and read
conceptual assets.reasoning: `w_pnt` and `r_pnt` are state registers reset at lines 73-74 and updated from `w_nxt` and `r_nxt` at lines 76-77; the next-state logic is defined at lines 82-83. Their low bits index `fifo_mem` for writes at lines 150/184 and for synchronous readout at line 241, and their relationship defines `match`, `full`, `empty`, and `level` at lines 92-95 or 102-105. Integrity is established because corruption changes storage order, selected read location, and the derived occupancy/status results. Availability is established because the registers preserve this state between clock edges and are reinitialized by `rstn_i`, while `clear_i` forces zero next state at lines 82-83 for capture on the next rising edge.

conceptual assets.concept: Current fill-level value reported by the module
conceptual assets.reasoning: For `fifo_depth_c > 1`, line 95 derives `level` from `unsigned(w_pnt) - unsigned(r_pnt)`; for the single-entry build, line 105 derives `level` from `full`. Lines 116-117 zero-extend and drive that value onto `level_o`. Integrity is established because the report flow defines `level_o` from this computed fill value, and `half` also depends on `level` at line 96.

Line 110 computes `free` as `not full`. That decision is consumed by line 65 when `FIFO_SAFE = true` and is exported on `free_o` at line 217 in the asynchronous-status build or at line 254 in the synchronous-status build. Integrity is established because both safe write acceptance and the reported output depend on exactly this value.

Line 111 computes `avail` as `not empty`. That decision is consumed by line 64 when `FIFO_SAFE = true` and is exported on `avail_o` at line 218 in the asynchronous-status build or at line 255 in the synchronous-status build. Integrity is established because both safe read acceptance and the reported output depend on exactly this value.

conceptual assets.concept: Occupancy-threshold flag reported by the module
conceptual assets.reasoning: For `fifo_depth_c > 1`, line 96 computes `half` from `level(level'left-1) or full`; for the single-entry build, line 106 copies `full` into `half`. That flag is exported on `half_o` at line 219 in the asynchronous-status build or at line 256 in the synchronous-status build. Integrity is established because the report flow defines the output from this threshold decision.
